investigation_trail.summary: planner handoff to PLANNING: consumer_saturation confirmed; restart_consumer_group applies
plan: restart_consumer_group({"consumer_group": "worker-dispatcher"}) then verify via get_consumer_lag
verified: The verify probe reads lag 0 after the restart: the kill flag was cleared (kill_key_cleared=true), the supervisor re-spawned the consumer, and the backlog has drained.

findings: worker-dispatcher had stopped processing while retaining its group assignment; lag climbed to 15000. The agent restarted the consumer group (kill flag cleared); the supervisor re-spawned it and the follow-up probe shows lag back at 0.
recommendation: Monitor lag for the next 5 minutes to confirm sustained recovery. If the same alert re-fires within 30 minutes, escalate — a restart-loop suggests a deeper issue than saturation.
